title: Compression-Aware Abstention: Teaching LLMs to Refuse When KV-Compression Masks Remove Answer Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2608.29934v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: KV-cache compression reduces LLM inference memory by evicting context tokens, but when the evicted tokens contain answer-bearing evidence, the model may hallucinate instead of recognizing that the compressed context is insufficient. We address this failure from a behavioral perspective: to our knowledge, this is the first work to formulate compression-aware abstention as a learning problem, in which a model learns to answer when supporting evidence survives compression and abstain when it does not. We construct supervision from compressor survival masks and tight answer-bearing spans, labeling examples as Confident when evidence survives and Abstain when it is removed. A 10.1M-parameter LoRA adapter trained on ~2.6K MuSiQue 2-hop QA examples reduces base-model hallucinations by 97% under prompt-style truncation while preserving correct answering on evidence-retaining examples. translated_title: 压缩感知弃权：当KV压缩掩码移除答案证据时教会大语言模型拒绝回答
translated_abstract: KV缓存压缩通过驱逐上下文标记来减少大语言模型的推理内存，但当被驱逐的标记包含承载答案的证据时，模型可能会产生幻觉，而不是识别出压缩后的上下文信息不足。我们从行为角度解决这一失败问题：据我们所知，这是首个将“压缩感知弃权”表述为学习问题的工作，即模型学会在支持证据在压缩后得以保留时进行回答，在证据未被保留时选择弃权。我们根据压缩器的存活掩码和紧凑的答案承载区间构建监督信号，将证据存活的样本标记为“自信”，将证据被移除的样本标记为“弃权”。在约2.6K个MuSiQue两跳问答示例上训练的10.1M参数LoRA适配器，在提示式截断下将基础模型的幻觉减少了97%，同时在证据得以保留的示例上保持正确回答。与仅基于提示的弃权基线不同——这些基线往往会过度弃权……
tldr: 该论文首次将“压缩感知弃权”形式化为学习问题，利用压缩器存活掩码构建监督信号，训练轻量级LoRA适配器使大语言模型在KV压缩移除答案证据时学会拒绝回答，从而将幻觉减少97%而不损害正常回答能力。
en_tdlr: This paper is the first to formulate compression-aware abstention as a learning problem, constructing supervision from compressor survival masks to train a lightweight LoRA adapter that teaches LLMs to refuse answering when KV-compression removes answer evidence, reducing hallucinations by 97% while preserving correct answering.
